title: Concept: Python requirement declared only by exclusion
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement that names only a version to exclude, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every other release satisfies the line, including every future one, so the requirement is effectively unbounded.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Every other release satisfies the line, including every future one, so the requirement is effectively unbounded.
